pages.title: Day 5: Arctic Ridge / Day 9: Hydroponic Lab
pages.text: Arctic Ridge is Day 5 of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995). The same tune, the longest of the game at 3 minutes 17 seconds in VGMPF's list, plays on Day 9, Hydroponic Lab, where the boss is the Acrobat.

pages.title: Eye candy
pages.text: GamePro wrote in November 1995 that in Vectorman, "everything, including the backgrounds, is eye candy".
